Sawsbuck

Normal Grass

Unova · Generation 5

Sawsbuck is a Normal/Grass-type Season Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.9 m tall and weighs 92.5 kg. It evolves from Deerling. Its highest base stat is Attack (100), with a base stat total of 475.
